content:
name: Node.js CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Use Node.js LTS
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: lts/*
        cache: yarn
    - name: install dependencies
      run: yarn --frozen-lockfile
    - name: run test
      run: yarn test
